All runs listed many other matters (e.g. 1011-00003, 1012-00005, 1013-00005, 1014-00003, 1014-00004, 1017-00003/4, 1019-00001, 1021-00004/5, 1030-00002, 1035-00002/3).

first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review at [87] said about 60 surfaced matters were never opened and only about 20 were read; the next stage only grepped saved snippets.

runs.failure_point: A narrow phrase filter cut its candidate set to four matters, so twelve qualifying matters were never opened; most listed matters were outside the requested set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its per-matter file of relevant scan hits at [69] listed every qualifying matter, but the request-phrase filter it then wrote kept only four matters, and the candidate set never recovered the twelve dropped qualifying matters.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [73] named the narrow hand-built regex and said differently worded matters could be dropped; the agent mined the scan for statute and rule markers and read new candidates, but none of the dropped qualifying matters.

other_errors.why: Nine of the twelve listed matters are outside the requested set (complaints and demands of other matters).
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review said pre-filing and enforcement-only items might inflate the count; the edits only added scope labels.

runs.failure_point: A narrow phrase filter dropped four qualifying matters, three read matters were excluded, and most listed matters were outside the requested set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its court-document-file scan at [43] reached four qualifying matters that the direct-request-phrase filter it then wrote dropped, and its candidate set came only from that filtered list, so they were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [55] said the direct-phrase regex was narrow and asked for a looser pass; the agent read only matters from the filtered list.

other_errors.why: It read three qualifying matters (status report, defence brief, engagement letter and closing memo at [69]-[131]) and excluded them as requests by the other side, an analysis of non-recoverability, or a defendant with no claim of its own.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) Reviews at [83], [109] and [133] named each of the three as judged from one partial read and asked for the operative filings; the agent did not reopen them.

other_errors.why: Most of the 21 listed matters are outside the requested set, including reservation-only and unfiled draft-demand matters.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The check review at [146] asked to confirm the reservation-only and contemplated-demand entries; the agent relabelled them but kept them in the list.

divergence: All three failed the same way in kind: every run's scans reached all qualifying matters, then a narrowing step dropped some before any read (T0 chose 20 matters to read and left six out; T1 and T2 wrote request-phrase filters over saved scan output that dropped twelve and four), and all three answers listed many matters outside the requested set (over-inclusion). T0 and T2 also excluded qualifying matters after one partial read (the request attributed to the other side). T1 failed worst at its filter stage. Reviews named the narrow filters specifically in T1 and T2 (T1 acted partly, T2 ignored), named T2's partial-read exclusions specifically, and raised over-inclusion only generically or as labelling; in T1 the later reviews pushed toward demoting two qualifying matters, which the agent did not do.
